exposure: induction of labor (IOL) following successful external cephalic version (ECV)
Induction of labor following successful external cephalic version
cohort: Women who underwent successful external cephalic version
finding: Induction of labor after successful external cephalic version was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Induction of labor after successful ECV was not shown to influence cesarean delivery rates.
